# Director of Marketing Operations & Integration

Company: Example Brand Group
Tracker ID: example_brand_group_marketing_operations_integration
Location: Hybrid
Official URL: https://example.invalid/jobs/marketing-operations-integration

## Job Description

Lead Marketing Operations and integration across a multi-brand portfolio. Build centralized shared services spanning shared creative resources, PR resources, digital resources, and technology resources. Standardize workflows and SOPs, establish intake and prioritization, improve resource allocation, and create cross-brand playbooks.

Own brand onboarding and integration, MarTech adoption, centralized repositories, digital asset workflows, and portfolio visibility. Implement marketing technology, improve platform adoption, and lead change management, training, and governance. Partner with vendors to drive vendor consolidation, vendor efficiencies, and stronger resource prioritization. Improve throughput and time to market while preserving the needs of individual brands.
